name: gas_turbine_any_regime
title: Single-shaft gas turbine at any regime
summary: Steady exercise of a single-shaft gas turbine burning methane in air. The compressor reduced flow and isentropic efficiency are interpolated from a three-row map against the pressure ratio; the expander reduced flow and isentropic efficiency are constant.

origin.course: ULiège MSTh, machines et systèmes thermiques, repetition R9 exercise 2

verification.summary: Stored solution of MSTH-SB-R9-EX2.EES (EES X7.458). compare_solution.py: 42 common variables, 12 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 8. Shaft power 328144 W versus 328445 W; eta 0.21372 versus 0.21366; air flow 1.97151 versus 1.97150 kg/s. Largest relative difference is q_2 (9.412e-3), the same ratio as cp(CH4). The window has no enthalpy or entropy.
verification.reference: EES stored solution of MSTH-SB-R9-EX2.EES (42 numeric values of 45 names, EES X7.458)
verification.notes: Maximum relative difference is shared by q_2 and cp_g (22205.98 versus 22416.96 J/kg, and 2220.60 versus 2241.70 J/kg-K). q_2 = cp_g*(T_ref-T_1) with both temperatures fixed, so the ratio is the cp(CH4) gap. cp(Air) is about 0.23% high (cp_a_1, cp_a_c). The equation window and the stored solution have no enthalpy and no entropy. gamma, N and N_R are in the EES variable list with no stored value (the N_R line is a comment). The eight CoolSolve-only names are unused outputs of the two cpbar CALLs (Q_4_23, x_23, e_min_23, e_23, Q_4_34, x_34, e_min_34, e_34). All 50 equations are satisfied (max |residual| 1.05e-9).
